name: ask-user-dialog
notes: Renders ABOVE bypass_permissions_dialog specifically so a startup risk prompt can never obscure the model's question — the Z-order comment on that render call is the whole point of this scenario. Reachable since MockAgentEvent grew a user_question variant: run_headless already builds the unbounded user-question channel and App::run already drains it into ask_user_dialog, so the mock path sends on that same channel.
